note: Halloween weekend across the five boroughs — zoo Boo plus free park festivals.

picks.reason: Boo at the Bronx Zoo — costumed animal treat stations and hayrides, included with admission.
Free Autumn Festival in the Bronx — games, crafts and seasonal food with NYC Parks.
Batty Over Halloween at Astoria Park — free costumes, candy and family activities in Queens.
Halloween Boo Bash on Randall's Island — free games and treats with skyline views.
Fall Festival at Lakeside in Prospect Park — boating, music and autumn food in Brooklyn.
